Monnik Monday Recovery Ride

Louisville, KY · Schnitzelburg · Road · Social

Beginner friendly

Monnik Monday Recovery Ride is a road and social group ride in Louisville, KY. It rolls every Monday at 6:15 pm from Monnik Beer Company. About 10–15 miles, 10–15 mph, actual recovery pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @crazyridenfadencyclists the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monnik Monday Recovery Ride group ride

A really slow recovery ride from Monnik in Schnitzelburg. Ten to fifteen miles at ten to fifteen mph, then a discounted pint back at the brewery.
